name: 55972 · Saint Charles, MN
findings: ZIP 55972 (Saint Charles) has 29 nonprofit organizations. 12 of them (41%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 9 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (40% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 55972 (Saint Charles) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 55972 (Saint Charles) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.6 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 9 organizations here; 41% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are public events so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
